rationale: C01 is an earlier installment of the same Selective Service Regulations under the 1948 Act. It establishes the regulatory codification, personnel, local-board structure, forms, registration duties, and administrative vocabulary that the child directly continues with later Parts 621–627 governing classification. This is materially stronger than mere topical similarity: the child operates as a subsequent tranche of the same integrated regulatory scheme and repeatedly relies on machinery and forms established in C01. C08 concerns the same program and supplies related registration rules, but it is a proclamation focused on registration dates rather than a close drafting template for the classification regulations. C23 likewise embeds detailed agency regulations in a presidential proclamation, but that general promulgation structure is less distinctive and concerns unrelated machinery.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I hereby prescribe the following portions of the regulations governing the administration of Title I of the said Act, which shall constitute portions of Parts 621 to 627, inclusive, of Title 32, chapter VI, Code of Federal Regulations, such regulations to be known as the Selective Service Regulations
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The definitions contained in section 16 of title I of the Selective Service Act of 1948 and the definitions contained in this part shall govern in the interpretation of the Selective Service Regulations.
shared_material.explanation: Both are installments of the same expressly named and codified body of presidential regulations under Title I of the 1948 Act.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The local board may from day to day as the Registration Cards (SSS Form No. 1) are received from the registrars or the State Director of Selective Service
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The State Director of Selective Service for each State shall divide his State into local board areas.... The jurisdiction of each local board shall extend to all persons registered in, or subject to registration in, the area for which it was appointed.
shared_material.explanation: The child directly deploys the local-board and State Director administrative structure prescribed in C01.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Classification Questionnaires (SSS Form No. 100) shall be mailed to registrants... Before a Classification Questionnaire... is mailed, it shall be prepared by filling in all blanks on page 1.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: All forms and revisions thereof referred to in these or any new or additional regulations... shall be and become a part of these regulations in the same manner as if each form... were set forth herein in full.
shared_material.explanation: C01 establishes the formal SSS-form machinery that the child concretely extends through questionnaires, cover sheets, classification records, and subpoenas.
